findings.title: Reject lone surrogate Unicode object names as invalid input

reproduction.transport: content=json.dumps(payload), which emits ASCII JSON escape for the surrogate

findings.cause: JSON accepts escaped lone surrogate. _changes passes object name unchanged; NativeStore object-name validation permits it, then canonical UTF-8 request hashing raises UnicodeEncodeError outside the mapped NativeStoreError/sqlite3 errors.
findings.recommendation: Validate Unicode scalar names before store invocation (or map UnicodeError narrowly to 422); add a real HTTP regression proving no stored candidate.

adversarial_observations.invalid_parameters: base integer/list, dependency revision integer/list, module integer, selected revision integer all 422

assessment.authentication: Native routes derive tenant/actor from verified strict identity or stored Bearer sessions, ignore X-Actor, reject viewers on writes; expiry/revocation and strict tenant controls covered. Existing shared identity connection methods use RLock transaction wrapper; new native lookups run in threadpool.
assessment.isolation_integrity: Cross-tenant revision/object/composition reads reject; corrupt bytes reject on object/composition readback.
assessment.bounds: Supplied tests verify Content-Length rejection, stream termination after crossing bound, decoded/object/entry/module bounds. Tests lower bounds for economy; full-limit memory profiling not performed.
assessment.concurrency_retry: Supplied tests cover parallel identical request retry and exact 409 mismatch; independent actor/tenant scope tests pass; real SQLite lock maps 503 Retry-After then retry succeeds.
assessment.read_semantics: Revised design only accepts reads=null. Explicit lists rejected, preserving conservative module-drift conflicts; unrelated module updates do not invalidate base.
assessment.startup: Startup test forbids subprocess/GitService/MergeQueue construction in native mode; fallback Git mode starts with worker disabled.
assessment.authority: Candidate APIs do not emit approvals, check success, releases or consumption receipts.

limitations: Native startup currently mounts identity, health and native candidate routes only; document/issue/model and broader platform integration remain later work.
No production service installation, switching, external network acceptance, release approval or parent-goal completion claimed.
This review binds the exact five files; source changes invalidate this verdict and require re-review.
Production access middleware retains existing synchronous identity checks; the event-loop responsiveness test specifically covers non-production native identity lookup.
No full tenant admission migration or trusted read tracking implementation included.
cleanup: No product source edits, commits or pushes. Adversarial scripts ran from stdin; TemporaryDirectory databases removed on context exit. pytest cache disabled and Python bytecode writing disabled.
